canonical_key.description: The resolution key that joins this subcontractor to its vendor node and across systems

counterparty_role.description: The party's role on this record — subcontractor, distinct from a plain vendor/supplier

identifier_authority.description: The register or authority that issued/validates the identifier

identifier_scheme.description: Scheme that qualifies `identifier_value` (ABN / NZBN / SAM UEI / company registration)

legal_entity_id.description: The tenant company/legal entity the subcontractor record is scoped to

legal_representative.description: The party's legal representative(s), where disclosed

observed_at.description: When this record was observed by the harvest

registration_status.description: Whether the party's registration is active at the source

source_external_id.description: The raw supplier record id in the producing system

source_system.description: The bound system that produced this record (`ASSIGNAR`)

subcontractor_entity_id.description: The canonical VENDOR spine node this fact is about

trading_name.description: Trading name where it differs from the registered name
